name: subagent-advisor
description: Watches the prompt you submit and, when the task looks better delegated to subagents (broad search, independent parts, long research, large diff review, bulk reads), shows a brief toast saying why and which kind. Also nudges after many sequential Read/Grep/Glob calls in one turn. Heuristics only: no model calls, holds a qualifying prompt and asks (or auto-decides) whether to delegate; if the question fails the prompt goes through unchanged. When you choose subagents it can also queue the agents panel (/agents-info open, from the separate savvy-progress mod) and the engine's /tasks view, to run when that turn ends; both are skipped quietly where the session does not list them.

enabled.title: Advise on subagents
enabled.description: Show subagent suggestions. /subagent-advisor on|off overrides this once used.

mode.title: When a prompt suits subagents
mode.description: ask: hold the prompt and ask (use subagents, continue, or switch to auto). auto-delegate: always add a subagent instruction without asking. auto-continue: never ask, toast only. off: silent. /subagent-advisor mode <x> overrides this once used.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: high suggests more often (one clear signal is enough), low only when several signals agree.

toolCallNudge.title: Nudge after many Read/Grep/Glob calls
toolCallNudge.description: Show one gentle toast per turn once the main thread has made many sequential Read, Grep or Glob calls.

openViews.title: Open the agents panel and background tasks
openViews.description: After you choose subagents (Use subagents, Auto: always use subagents, or auto-delegate mode), queue /agents-info open (needs the savvy-progress mod) and the built-in /tasks, where the session lists them. They run when that turn ends. /subagent-advisor views on|off overrides this once used.
